blocks.en: The market price of our Class A common stock may decline due to sales of a large number of shares of our Class A common stock in the market after this offering. The potential for such sales to occur may also depress the market price of our Class A common stock. Following the completion of this offering and the concurrent private placement, based on 6,626,640,437 shares of our Class A common stock outstanding and 5,307,329,452 shares of Class N common stock outstanding as of September 30, 2026 (after giving effect to the Preferred Stock Conversion, Convertible Notes Conversion, Initial Public Benefit Issuance , and RSU Settlement), we will have a total of 7,427,991,791 shares of Class A common stock outstanding and 5,658,680,800 shares of Class N common stock outstanding. Our directors, executive officers, and the holders of substantially all of our capital stock and securities convertible into or exchangeable for our capital stock have entered into market standoff agreements with us or have entered or will enter into lock-up agreements with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, on behalf of the underwriters, under which they have agreed, subject to specific exceptions including specified early expiration provisions, to certain restrictions on their ability to transfer any shares of our Class A common stock or Class N common stock or securities directly or indirectly convertible into or exchangeable or exercisable for our Class A common stock or Class N common stock during the period ending (i) in the case of our co-founders and certain of our stockholders holding more than 0.5% of our fully diluted shares prior to this offering, on the earlier of (A) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2027 and (B) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 365th day after the date of this prospectus, and (ii) in the case of all other such holders, on the earlier of (A) 6:00 AM Eastern Time on the second full trading day immediately following the public release of our quarterly financial results for the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2027 and (B) immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th day after the date of this prospectus. In addition, up to 316 million shares of our Class A common stock may become eligible for sale beginning on the first trading day following the date of this prospectus, and up to 3.3 billion additional shares may become eligible for sale prior to the expiration of the period described in clause (ii) above. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC may release stockholders from the lock-up agreements, and we may, generally only with their consent, release stockholders from the market standoff agreements, in each case prior to the end of the applicable period. See the sections titled "Underwriting" and "Shares Eligible for Future Sale—Lock-Up and Market Standoff Agreements" for further information about these agreements, including the specified early expiration provisions. The shares of our Class N common stock to be sold in the concurrent private placement will not be subject to any market standoff agreement or lock-up agreement. These shares will be "restricted securities" under the Securities Act and may be resold only pursuant to an effective registration statement or an available exemption from registration, including Rule 144, and certain of the purchasers may have registration rights as described under "Description of Capital Stock—Registration Rights." Because shares of our Class N common stock convert into shares of our Class A common stock upon a qualifying transfer, sales of these shares, or the perception that such sales may occur, could cause the market price of our Class A common stock to decline.
blocks.ko: 본 공모 이후 시장에서 당사 A종 보통주가 대량 매도되는 경우 당사 A종 보통주의 시장가격이 하락할 수 있다. 이러한 매도가 발생할 가능성만으로도 당사 A종 보통주의 시장가격이 하락할 수 있다. 본 공모 및 동시 사모 완료 후, 2026년 9월 30일 현재 발행주식인 A종 보통주 6,626,640,437주 및 N종 보통주 5,307,329,452주(우선주 전환, 전환사채 전환, 최초 공익 발행 및 RSU 결제를 반영한 후)를 기준으로, 당사의 발행주식 총수는 A종 보통주 7,427,991,791주 및 N종 보통주 5,658,680,800주가 된다. 당사의 이사, 집행임원 및 당사 자본주식과 당사 자본주식으로 전환 또는 교환 가능한 증권의 실질적으로 전부를 보유한 보유자들은 당사와 시장 매도 유보 약정(market standoff agreement)을 체결하였거나, 인수인을 대표하는 Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC 및 Morgan Stanley & Co. blocks.en: As a result of these agreements and the provisions of our amended and restated investors' rights agreement, dated as of May 28, 2026 (our "IRA"), as described further in the section titled "Description of Capital Stock— Registration Rights," and subject to the provisions of Rule 144 or Rule 701 under the Securities Act, additional shares of our Class A common stock (including shares issuable upon conversion of our Class N common stock) will become available for sale in the public market at various times after the date of this offering, beginning on the first trading day following the date of this prospectus. Because shares released from these restrictions will become freely tradable simultaneously with the shares sold in this offering, purchasers of our Class A common stock in the public market following this offering may be unable to determine whether their shares were issued pursuant to the registration statement of which this prospectus forms a part. The ability to bring a claim under Section 11 or Section 12(a)(2) of the Securities Act requires that the security purchased be traceable to the allegedly defective registration statement, and tracing shares to this registration statement may be more difficult because registered and unregistered shares begin trading at approximately the same time. As a result, such purchasers may be unable to assert claims under Section 11 or Section 12(a)(2) of the Securities Act for any material misstatements or omissions in the registration statement or this prospectus. See the section titled "Shares Eligible for Future Sale" for additional information.
